top_signals.index_note: Classified editorial_amplified rather than designer_originated: the trend claim is the outlets' synthesis of spectator styling and search behavior around a recurring annual sporting event, not a single designer's seasonal collection statement. Same event-driven volatility pattern as prior Royal Ascot/tomato-red and royal-purple signals -- expect coverage to fade with the tournament rather than persist as an independent fashion-cycle development.
top_signals.human_editor_note: Held at 'medium' despite four corroborating outlets: three of the four domains (hellomagazine.com, yourcoffeebreak.co.uk, vogueadria.com) aren't in DOMAIN_SECTOR_MAP and classify 'unclear', so the apparent editorial diversity is thinner than the raw count suggests -- the same taxonomy-coverage caveat applied to every color/event-dressing signal this quarter. The reported search-volume spikes are self-reported by one of the covering outlets rather than independently verified, so I'm treating them as corroborating color but not as a separate data point.
